title: Kanan Ke Kiri
subject: a signboard painter with thirty years of steady hands who cannot read Jawi, joining a Tuesday-night adult Jawi class in the community hall so he can repaint the cloth shop's sign without getting a single letter backwards
caption: Malay post-punk with a cold-wave edge, in the line of late-70s and 80s British post-punk kept alive by long-running Malaysian bands. A melodic, chorus-effected bass played high on the neck carrying the riff; an angular, trebly flanged guitar in clipped single-note stabs and ringing open chords; tight, dry motorik drums with a busy hi-hat; a cold monophonic synth drone with an occasional clipped synth-string line. Dry, close, slightly lo-fi 80s mix with spring reverb on the guitar. Male baritone, deadpan, low and steady, chanting the hook with flat restraint and lifting into a strained shout on the last chorus. 148 BPM, B minor. Tense, wry and stubborn. No pop-punk, no shoegaze wall of sound, no synthwave, no autotune, no trap drums.
lyrics:
[Intro - chorused bass riff, motorik drums, cold synth drone]

[Verse 1]
Tiga puluh tahun aku cat papan tanda
Huruf rumi, merah, kuning, pejam mata pun boleh
Haji Osman nak nama kedai kain dia dalam Jawi
Aku tengok huruf tu macam tengok wayar berselirat

[Pre-Chorus]
Selasa malam, dewan orang ramai
Lima belas orang tua, buku latihan budak darjah satu

[Chorus]
Kanan ke kiri, kanan ke kiri
Tangan aku melawan arah sendiri
Alif, ba, ta, titik bawah, titik atas
Kanan ke kiri, jangan terbalik lagi

[Verse 2]
Ustazah ketuk meja, "Ini nga, bukan ain"
"Kira titik dia, pak cik, tiga, bukan satu"
Kertas latihan aku tampal kat dinding bengkel
Pukul dua pagi aku masih lukis huruf sin

[Chorus]
Kanan ke kiri, kanan ke kiri
Berus aku belajar jalan sendiri
Kaf, lam, nga, tiga titik di atas
Kanan ke kiri, jangan terbalik lagi

[Bridge - bass and drums only, guitar feedback rising]
Sabtu pagi atas tangga besi depan kedai
Haji Osman baca dari bawah, satu-satu, tak ada yang salah

[Chorus - shouted]
Kanan ke kiri, kanan ke kiri
Cat kuning belum kering lagi
Orang lalu berhenti, dongak, membaca
Kanan ke kiri, tak terbalik lagi

[Outro - bass riff alone, then a hard stop]
